name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 148 drones, 3 missiles 21 Nov after mass strike
summary: Russia fired 148 drones and 3 ballistic missiles on 21 Nov, after its 20 Nov mass strike; 2 killed, 83 injured
state: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched three ballistic missiles and 148 drones overnight into 21 Nov, hitting 19 locations; at least two people were killed and 83 injured over the day, 58 of them in Kryvyi Rih (Kyiv Independent). This followed the 20 Nov assault of 84 cruise missiles and 404 drones on energy targets, bridges and homes. A Russian missile and drone also entered Polish airspace on 20 Nov (RTE). Mass-casualty strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Energy cuts and strikes on cities continue across Ukraine. The FCDO advises against all travel to Ukraine; anyone there can follow local air-raid alerts.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty strikes — 84 cruise missiles and 404 drones on 20 Nov, 148 drones on 21 Nov
